title: Costa–Morini–Pasotti–Pellegrini restricted rotational sequencing conjecture
statement:
Let $G$ be an abelian group and let $S$ be a finite subset of $G\setminus\{0\}$ such that

$$
\Sigma S=0
$$

and $|S\cap\{x,-x\}|\leq1$ for every $x\in G$. **Costa–Morini–Pasotti–Pellegrini conjecture.** Then $S$ has a rotational sequencing. This weaker conjecture than the main strong sequenceability conjecture is sufficient for some applications to Heffter arrays; the supplied status evidence does not resolve it.
source_name: Simone Costa, Stefano Della Fiore, M. A. Ollis and Sarah Z. Rovner-Frydman, “On Sequences in Cyclic Groups with Distinct Partial Sums”, arXiv:2203.16658 (2022).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.16658

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of March 2022). “Friedlander, Gordon and Miller conjectured the rotational sequenceability version in 1978 and this was recently resolved by Alspach, Kreher and Pastine .”
